coins.name: Denarii
coins.examine: Silver coins stamped with the emperor's face.

raw_meat.name: Raw meat
raw_meat.examine: Fresh, but you'd want to cook it.

cooked_sardine.name: Sardine
cooked_sardine.examine: Grilled, with a pinch of salt.

bread.name: Bread
bread.examine: A round loaf of panis quadratus.

strix_feather.name: Strix feather
strix_feather.examine: It is cold to the touch.

whitethorn_charm.name: Whitethorn charm
whitethorn_charm.examine: A sprig of whitethorn bound with red thread. The strix fear it.

bronze_pickaxe.name: Bronze pickaxe
bronze_pickaxe.examine: For mining copper, tin and iron.

hunting_bow.name: Hunting bow
hunting_bow.examine: An arcus of ash wood. Good for hares, better for wolves.

composite_bow.name: Composite bow
composite_bow.examine: Horn, sinew and wood. An auxiliary archer's weapon.

sling.name: Sling
sling.examine: A funda of braided wool. The Balearic islanders swear by them.

iron_arrow.name: Iron arrow
iron_arrow.examine: An iron point. It bites deep.

lead_glans.name: Lead glans
lead_glans.examine: An acorn-shaped lead bullet. Someone scratched 'TAKE THAT' on it.

amentum.name: Amentum
amentum.examine: A leather throwing loop. Wound round a javelin's shaft, it spins the throw and nearly doubles the distance.

bronze_javelin.name: Bronze javelin
bronze_javelin.examine: A light verutum with a bronze head. Thrown, not shot.

iron_javelin.name: Iron javelin
iron_javelin.examine: An iron-headed verutum. It punches through hide.

steel_pilum.name: Steel pilum
steel_pilum.examine: A legionary's pilum: a long steel shank that bends in a shield and won't come out.

galena.name: Galena
galena.examine: Heavy grey ore. Rome's lead comes from this.

lead_sheet.name: Lead sheet
lead_sheet.examine: A thin, soft sheet of lead, ready to take an inscription.

bronze_nails.name: Bronze nails
bronze_nails.examine: Small bronze nails. Good for binding things in place.

stylus.name: Stylus
stylus.examine: A pointed bronze pen for writing on wax, or on lead.

binding_tablet.name: Binding tablet
binding_tablet.examine: A rolled lead curse, nailed shut. 'I bind his tongue, his hands, his feet.'

withering_tablet.name: Withering tablet
withering_tablet.examine: Grave ash pressed into the lead. 'May his limbs waste as this lead grows cold.'

lituus.name: Lituus
lituus.examine: An augur's curved staff. The Manes listen to those who carry one.

ritual_robe.name: Ritual robe
ritual_robe.examine: Dark wool, unbleached. It wards off curses, not arrows.

ritual_hood.name: Ritual hood
ritual_hood.examine: Worn so the gods don't see your face.

incense.name: Incense
incense.examine: Frankincense from the East. The gods like the smell.

wine.name: Wine
wine.examine: A jug of rough red. Some for the gods, some for you.

silencing_tablet.name: Silencing tablet
silencing_tablet.examine: Strix feather pinned in the lead. 'Let his blows fall on nothing.'

manes_tablet.name: Tablet of the Manes
manes_tablet.examine: Ash and feather sealed in lead. 'Spirits of the dead, rise and take him.'

logs.name: Logs
logs.examine: Rough-cut wood. It would burn, or whittle.

small_net.name: Small net
small_net.examine: A hand net, for small fish in shallow water.

fishing_rod.name: Fishing rod
fishing_rod.examine: A reed rod with a horsehair line and a bronze hook.

raw_anchovy.name: Raw anchovies
raw_anchovy.examine: A handful of tiny silver fish. Garum makers want these.

cooked_anchovy.name: Anchovies
cooked_anchovy.examine: Crisp, salty, and gone in a mouthful.

cooked_mackerel.name: Mackerel
cooked_mackerel.examine: Oily and rich. Romans swear by it.

arrow_shaft.name: Arrow shaft
arrow_shaft.examine: A straight wooden shaft, ready for fletching.

bowstring.name: Bowstring
bowstring.examine: Twisted sinew, waxed against the damp.

parma.name: Parma
parma.examine: A round auxiliary shield, battered and repainted many times.

lorica_hamata.name: Lorica hamata
lorica_hamata.examine: A shirt of riveted iron rings. Heavy, but it turns a blade.

silver_fibula.name: Silver fibula
silver_fibula.examine: A silver cloak brooch, worked like a crossbow.

boar_hide.name: Boar hide
boar_hide.examine: A coarse, bristly hide. It needs tanning.

leather.name: Leather
leather.examine: Tanned boar hide, tough and supple.

needle.name: Needle
needle.examine: A bronze needle for heavy stitching.

leather_cap.name: Leather cap
leather_cap.examine: A close-fitting cap of boiled leather.

leather_jerkin.name: Leather jerkin
leather_jerkin.examine: A sleeveless leather coat. Light enough to draw a bow in.

wolfskin_hood.name: Wolfskin hood
wolfskin_hood.examine: A wolf's head and pelt, worn as a hood. The aquiliferi would approve.

wolfskin_jerkin.name: Wolfskin jerkin
wolfskin_jerkin.examine: Leather lined and trimmed with wolf fur. Warm on the frontier.

stolen_pay_chest.name: Stolen pay chest
stolen_pay_chest.examine: A small iron-bound chest stamped with the cohort's mark. It's heavy with silver.

spatha.name: Spatha
spatha.examine: A long cavalry sword. It reaches where a gladius can't.

salt.name: Salt
salt.examine: Coarse sea salt, carted up from the coast.

garum.name: Garum
garum.examine: Fermented fish sauce in a small amphora. Pungent, precious, and on every Roman table.

mackerel_in_garum.name: Mackerel in garum
mackerel_in_garum.examine: Grilled mackerel glazed with garum and pepper.

anchovies_in_garum.name: Anchovy relish
anchovies_in_garum.examine: Anchovies pounded with garum and herbs, spread on bread.

black_beans.name: Black beans
black_beans.examine: Nine black beans, for the rite of the Lemuria. Throw them behind you, and don't look back.

larval_shroud.name: Larval shroud
larval_shroud.examine: A grave-cloth that still stirs on its own. The Manes listen to whoever wears it.

diploma.name: Bronze diploma
diploma.examine: Two bronze tablets, wired shut: your honourable discharge and grant of Roman citizenship, witnessed by seven.

box_trap.name: Box trap
box_trap.examine: A wooden box with a trip-stick. Hares are curious; foxes, less so.

fox_pelt.name: Fox pelt
fox_pelt.examine: A thick red pelt with a white-tipped brush.

trowel.name: Trowel
trowel.examine: A small iron trowel for planting.

fennel_seed.name: Fennel seed
fennel_seed.examine: Striped fennel seeds. They smell of aniseed.

wormwood_seed.name: Wormwood seed
wormwood_seed.examine: Wormwood seeds, as bitter as the plant.

cabbage_seed.name: Cabbage seed
cabbage_seed.examine: Brassica seed. Cato swore by cabbage for everything.

poppy.name: Poppy
poppy.examine: A red poppy head, heavy with milk.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.examine: A crisp green cabbage. Cato would approve.

broad_beans.name: Broad beans
broad_beans.examine: A double handful of broad beans.

honey.name: Honey
honey.examine: A small pot of thyme honey.

mortar_and_pestle.name: Mortar and pestle
mortar_and_pestle.examine: A stone mortar and pestle, for grinding herbs.

mint_tonic.name: Mint tonic
mint_tonic.examine: Mint steeped in wine. It sharpens the eye and the hand.

fennel_draught.name: Fennel draught
fennel_draught.examine: Fennel in wine. Gladiators drank it for strength.

sage_salve.name: Sage salve
sage_salve.examine: Sage worked into honey. Rubbed on before a fight, it toughens the skin.

wormwood_bitters.name: Wormwood bitters
wormwood_bitters.examine: Wormwood in wine, bitter as a lost war. It steadies the aim.

poppy_draught.name: Poppy draught
poppy_draught.examine: Poppy milk in honey. It dulls pain, and knits wounds faster.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.examine: A barbed iron harpoon on a long ash shaft.

raw_tuna.name: Raw tuna
raw_tuna.examine: A thick-bodied tunny, fresh from the deep.

cooked_tuna.name: Tuna
cooked_tuna.examine: A tunny steak, grilled over vine-wood.

eel_pot.name: Eel pot
eel_pot.examine: A narrow wicker trap. Eels swim in and can't find the way out.

raw_eel.name: Raw eel
raw_eel.examine: A long, slippery marsh eel. It's still wriggling.

cooked_eel.name: Eel
cooked_eel.examine: Eel roasted on a skewer, the Greek way.

harpy_feather.name: Harpy feather
harpy_feather.examine: A long brown feather that smells of storms. Fletchers prize them.

harpy_arrow.name: Harpy arrow
harpy_arrow.examine: Fletched with harpy feathers. It flies as if it hated its target.

plank.name: Plank
plank.examine: A sawn plank of common wood.

oak_plank.name: Oak plank
oak_plank.examine: A heavy oak plank, straight and true.

gold_ore.name: Gold ore
gold_ore.examine: Heavy, and yellow where the rock has split. Worth the risk.

gold_bar.name: Gold bar
gold_bar.examine: A bar of soft, bright gold.

gold_torc.name: Gold torc
gold_torc.examine: A twisted gold neck-ring in the Germanic style. Chieftains wear these.

framea.name: Framea
framea.examine: A Germanic spear with a short, narrow head. Light enough to throw, sharp enough to keep.

dire_wolf_pelt.name: Dire wolf pelt
dire_wolf_pelt.examine: Coarse black fur from a wolf the size of a pony.

warchiefs_helm.name: War-chief's helm
warchiefs_helm.examine: An iron helm with a boar crest, taken from the war-chief beyond the Limes.

legion_eagle.name: Legion eagle
legion_eagle.examine: A cohort's eagle standard, tarnished green. Priceless to any legionary: you'd never leave it behind.

mole.name: Mole
mole.examine: It followed you up out of the quarry and won't go back down.

magpie.name: Magpie
magpie.examine: A bird after your own heart. It keeps looking at your purse.

leveret.name: Leveret
leveret.examine: A young hare that decided your traps were a game.

wolf_cub.name: Wolf cub
wolf_cub.examine: One of the war-chief's hounds, still small enough to carry. It has decided you are its pack now.

venators_helm.name: Venator's helm
venators_helm.examine: A wolfskin hood with a whitethorn charm sewn into the brow. Venatores swear by it on contract.

beeswax.name: Beeswax
beeswax.examine: A soft yellow cake of wax from the temple's hives. Odysseus's crew would have wanted some.

wax_earplugs.name: Wax earplugs
wax_earplugs.examine: Linen pads packed with beeswax. The world goes quiet, and so do the sirens.

venators_helm_sealed.name: Venator's helm (sealed)
venators_helm_sealed.examine: A venator's helm with wax sewn into the ear flaps. Neither the strix nor the sirens get through.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.examine: A pearl from a drowned sailor's purse, or so the harbour says.

silver_ore.name: Silver ore
silver_ore.examine: Grey argentiferous rock, heavier than it looks. Hispania's wealth.

silver_bar.name: Silver bar
silver_bar.examine: A small ingot of refined silver, stamped by the procurator.

coal.name: Coal
coal.examine: Black and brittle. Burned with iron ore, it makes Noric steel.

steel_bar.name: Steel bar
steel_bar.examine: A bar of Noric steel, iron hardened in a coal fire. The legions' best.

steel_pugio.name: Steel pugio
steel_pugio.examine: A Noric steel dagger. Short, quick, and hard to blunt.

steel_gladius.name: Steel gladius
steel_gladius.examine: A gladius of Noric steel, the pride of the legions.

steel_galea.name: Steel galea
steel_galea.examine: A steel helmet with cheek guards.

steel_scutum.name: Steel scutum
steel_scutum.examine: A curved shield rimmed and bossed with steel.

steel_lorica.name: Steel lorica
steel_lorica.examine: Overlapping steel plates. Heavy, and almost nothing gets through.

steel_pickaxe.name: Steel pickaxe
steel_pickaxe.examine: Noric steel, for the hardest rock in Hispania.

steel_arrowheads.name: Steel arrowheads
steel_arrowheads.examine: Steel points, narrow enough to find the gap in mail.

steel_arrow.name: Steel arrow
steel_arrow.examine: A steel point. It goes through a shield.

mirror_shield.name: Mirror shield
mirror_shield.examine: A bronze shield polished like a mirror. Perseus would approve; the basilisk sees only itself.

basilisk_eye.name: Basilisk eye
basilisk_eye.examine: Dull and grey now. Still, you don't look at it for long.

crown_of_regulus.name: Crown of Regulus
crown_of_regulus.examine: A ring of golden horn from the basilisk king's brow. Basilisks see a king when they look at you, and look away.

basilisk_hatchling.name: Basilisk hatchling
basilisk_hatchling.examine: A basilisk no bigger than a cat. When it looks at you, your fingers tingle a little.

olives.name: Olives
olives.examine: A twist of cloth full of black olives from Seriphos.

cyclops_cheese.name: Cyclops cheese
cyclops_cheese.examine: A wheel of hard ewe's cheese from a cyclops's cave. Polyphemus made it better, they say.

gorgon_scale.name: Gorgon scale
gorgon_scale.examine: A bronze-green scale from a gorgon. It's warm, and it shouldn't be.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.examine: Athena's goatskin shield, set with a gorgon's face. What it shows, nothing wants to look at.

jewellers_tools.name: Jeweller's tools
jewellers_tools.examine: Files, a burin and a tiny hammer, rolled in leather.

silver_pendant.name: Silver pendant
silver_pendant.examine: A crescent moon in silver, sacred to Hecate. Curse-writers wear them.

amulet_of_diana.name: Amulet of Diana
amulet_of_diana.examine: Silver worked into a hunting hound. The huntress's hunters wear it.

gold_bulla.name: Gold bulla
gold_bulla.examine: A gold locket, like the one every freeborn Roman child wears against bad luck. Yours is bigger.

weighted_net.name: Weighted net
weighted_net.examine: A heavy rope net with lead weights round the edge. Throw it over something tired.

clay.name: Clay
clay.examine: A lump of wet grey clay from the pond's edge.

sand.name: Sand
sand.examine: Fine white sand from a Greek beach. Good for glass.

blowpipe.name: Blowpipe
blowpipe.examine: A long iron tube for gathering molten glass and blowing it into shape.

unfired_pot.name: Unfired pot
unfired_pot.examine: A pot of soft clay. It needs the kiln.

unfired_bowl.name: Unfired bowl
unfired_bowl.examine: A bowl of soft clay. It needs the kiln.

unfired_amphora.name: Unfired amphora
unfired_amphora.examine: A tall jar of soft clay, two handles and a point. It needs the kiln.

unfired_lamp.name: Unfired lamp
unfired_lamp.examine: A little oil lamp of soft clay. It needs the kiln.

clay_pot.name: Clay pot
clay_pot.examine: A plain fired pot. Every kitchen in the Empire has ten.

clay_bowl.name: Clay bowl
clay_bowl.examine: A red-glazed bowl, the kind they make by the thousand in Gaul.

amphora.name: Amphora
amphora.examine: A tall fired amphora, for wine, oil or garum.

oil_lamp.name: Oil lamp
oil_lamp.examine: A fired lamp with a little gladiator stamped on the top.

glass_vial.name: Glass vial
glass_vial.examine: A small vial of green glass, for perfume or medicine.

glass_bowl.name: Glass bowl
glass_bowl.examine: A bowl of clear blown glass. Rome would pay well for it.

firepot.name: Firepot
firepot.examine: A clay pot packed with olives and oil, a rag in the neck. Light it, throw it, run.

hydra_scale_lorica.name: Hydra-scale lorica
hydra_scale_lorica.examine: Overlapping green scales from the Hydra's necks, on a leather backing. They still turn a blade.

lorica_segmentata.name: Lorica segmentata
lorica_segmentata.examine: Bands of steel laced over leather: the legion's own armour. It takes a squire to buckle and a legionary to wear.

phalerae.name: Phalerae
phalerae.examine: Silver discs won for valour, worn on a harness over the armour.

gorgon_head.name: Gorgon's head
gorgon_head.examine: Wrapped in a sack, eyes shut. You don't check.
